title: Digital Behaviors
description: An ML-based Android app that analyzes smartphone usage patterns and predicts digital addiction.
points: Random Forest model reaching about 98% accuracy in digital addiction prediction.
Real-time collection of screen time, app usage and unlock frequency.
Secure sandbox with PIN-based authentication for controlled testing.
overview: Instead of treating screen time as one number, the app captures how often you unlock, switch apps and lose focus, then turns that into behavioral insight.
problem: Standard OS screen-time tools ignore context and fragmentation, so people can't see why their focus drops.
challenges: Keeping background battery drain low while collecting usage data.
Running the model fast enough on a phone.

title: Smart Waste Bin
description: An IoT waste segregation system that detects and sorts waste automatically using Arduino and sensors.
points: Hardware sensors detect and categorize waste types in real time.
Control logic drives automated segregation, cutting manual sorting effort.
overview: Built to sort waste at the source: ultrasonic and inductive sensors tell metallic from non-metallic items and servo flaps route them.
problem: Manual sorting is error-prone and often skipped.
challenges: Removing sensor jitter and false positives from fast item drops.
Calibrating servo limits to avoid jamming.
Keeping the control loop fast enough to react quickly.

title: E-KART
description: A cross-platform store management app with product recommendations and nearby-store price comparison.
points: Python (Kivy) app for inventory and store management.
Recommendations based on user interaction patterns.
Real-time availability and price comparison across nearby stores.
overview: E-KART joins inventory tracking, price comparison and recommendations in one interface for store managers and shoppers.
problem: Shoppers and store managers work from separate, disconnected views of stock and price.
challenges: A Kivy layout that scales across phone and tablet screens.
Fast search across hundreds of products.
Keeping business logic separate from the UI.
